title: Sanctions screening records
definition: The screening results for the customer, the counterparty and the payment, with the list versions used and the dates the screens were run. It is requested wherever a transaction involves a party in a higher-risk jurisdiction, and it establishes what was checked, against which list, and when — which is what decides whether the check was adequate.
evidence_to_cite: the screening results, with the list versions and the screening date
any hit, and the disposition of the hit, with the basis
the re-screening date, where the lists have changed since

sources.citation: Sanctions compliance and reporting obligations, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
